pr_title: mgmt: mcumgr: Add optional image number to erase command
pr_body:
Allows selecting which image will be erased, will default back to
image 1 as it would do in previous versions if the optional parameter
is not provided

Fixes #40855
pr_comments: Release notes added and documentation updated

issue_context.title: mgmt/mcumgr/lib: Add optional image/slot parameter to "image erase" mcumgr request command
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Currently the mcumgr library is hardcoded to always erase secondary slot of first image. With added support for multiple images, there are now possible more than one candidate for that erase command.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Add optional image/slot parameter that would allow to select which slot should be erased. When the field would not be present, then default action would taken.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
With existing progressive erase, the "erase" command may seem useless, but it is often used command and should be extended to support the mult-image.

**Additional context**
Currently the command does not take any parameters and is hardcoded to always erase secondary slot of primary image when mcumgr enabled application is enabled,. This command is not supported by mcuboot mcumgr implementation at all.
